newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo climbs on U.S. buying, bear squeeze.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo climbs on U.S. buying, bear squeeze.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome climbed 12-1/2p to 929p by 1328 GMT as U.S. buying buoyed the market, sparking a bear squeeze, traders said.
"We've seen American buying all day long," said one market maker.
Interest from U.S. investors precipitated a bear squeeze, pushing shares even higher, traders said.

Shares in Zeneca Group, which have been volatile in recent months amid persistent takeover rumours, also rose. They were up 10p to 1553 after setting a new record peak at 1563p. But shares in SmithKline Beecham were up only 1/2p to 748p.
